svg.aria-label: BCBC 2024 Article 9.9.6.3 Clear Opening Width at Doorways
svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.9.6.3 Clear Opening Width at Doorways
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.9 MEANS OF EGRESS
Clear Opening Width at Doorways
WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
The clear opening width of doorways complies with
Sentence (2) at
(a) exit doors, and (b) doors that open into or are
located within a public corridor or other facility
that provides access to exit from a suite. Except as
provided in Sentence (4).
These doorways are not less than
(a) 850 mm (33 7/16″) wide where there is only one
door leaf, (b) 850 mm wide where multiple-leaf doors
have only one active leaf with a latching mechanism
described in Article 9.9.6.7., and (c) 1 210 mm
(3′-11⅝″) wide where multiple-leaf doors have two
active leaves.
Where multiple-leaf doors are installed in these
doorways
(a) no active leaf is less than 850 mm wide where
only one leaf is active, and (b) no single leaf is
less than 610 mm (24″) wide where two leaves are
active.
Doorways serving a single dwelling unit or a
house with a secondary suite, including their
common spaces, need not comply with Sentence (2)
See also Article 9.5.5.1.
Drawn: three exit doorways, doors open toward the reader.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.9.6.3. (page 9-49)
